LOW_Guildhall_SlickInatra
Slick Inatra is a high half elven ranger and sergeant of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three. She is the local leader of the Zhent mercenaries, protecting the Guildhall against Stone Lord intrusions.
“
We're all on the same side, friend. Nine-Fingers invited us herself.
„
— Slick Inatra, to the Guild's Professor.

Involvement

Protecting the Guildhall

Inatra can be found in the Guildhall, where she can be first observed talking with  The Professor, reassuring them of their loyalty in regards to their alliance with the Guild.[1] Afterward, Inatra patrols the pit, southern and southwesthern half of the Guildhall, occasionally stopping to chat with other Zhentarim members. The  Caravan Strongbox can be given to her for a reward if the party decided to deliver it themselves. However, if the party gave the chest to  Zarys back in Act One, it can instead be pickpocketed from her or looted from her corpse. The  Iron Flask will still be inside.

During her patrol, she occasionally talks to her subordinates, telling them to be careful,[2] and that they are still waiting for orders.[3] She frequently stops by to chat with and chastise  Phase in particular, for his unflattering hygiene and his tendencies to play betting games.[4]

Battle for the Guildhall

If  Roah Moonglow,  Boss Friol, or  Trinoda attempts to take over the Guildhall, Inatra joins the fight alongside her Zhentarim allies against the Guild. Siding against the Zhentarim ends in Inatra's demise, or in her disappearance if she is knocked out.

If the party aid the Zhentarim to win the battle, and if she survives the fight in Guildhall, Inatra takes position at the door leading into the guildmaster's office. She remarks that she did truly respect  Nine-Fingers Keene, but nevertheless had no qualms following orders to attack her.[5]

Inatra can be summoned with  Gather Your Allies variant  Black Fist Enforcers, if the party completed ⁠Aid the Underduke and sided with the Zhentarim.

Idle banter

  • Slick Inatra
    We're all on the same side, friend. Nine-Fingers invited us herself.
  • The Professor
    The guildmaster hired you, yes - but I think it's best if your Zhentarim keep to themselves. There's not a lot of trust in the Guildhall of late.
  • Slick Inatra
    You're all scared shitless of this Stone Lord, you mean. Which is exactly why your boss hired us.
  • Slick Inatra
    Look, if your lot could look after themselves, we wouldn't need to be here.
  • The Professor
    The Guild is a collective of specialists - not a private army.
  • Slick Inatra
    'Specialists'. Thieves, con-artists, and killers - nothing so special about that, friend.
  • The Professor
    ...There are no killers here, Zhent. Assassins, those are a different matter entirely.
  • The Professor
    As you'll see, there's plenty of space for your people.
  • Slick Inatra
    Down there in the damp, you mean.
  • The Professor
    Count yourself lucky. This place is usually so full that you wouldn't find room to sit your padded arse down.
  • Slick Inatra
    Don't try to flirt with me, boss. We both know this place is like a tomb because your crews are running scared.
  • Slick Inatra
    And what are we meant to do about food?
  • The Professor
    Talk to Severn at the bar.
  • Slick Inatra
    What - the bugbear?
  • The Professor
    The guildmaster poached him from a minor peer of Parliament. He's quite the cook.
  • Slick Inatra
    I told our clients we'd be on our best behaviour. Everyone playing nice here?
  • Phase
    Not playing at all, boss.
  • Slick Inatra
    Even better.
  • Slick Inatra
    Make sure the others keep to themselves. This place is jumpy - better to give the Guildies their space.
  • Phase
    'S not like we're bloody diseased, boss.
  • Slick Inatra
    Worse, Phase - we're Zhentarim.
  • Phase
    What are we waiting for, Inatra? If we're meant to fight this Stone Lord, then let's bloody be about it.
  • Slick Inatra
    See my uniform, Phase? It's nicer than yours, agreed? And not just because I don't sleep in it.
  • Slick Inatra
    That's because I outrank you. So when I say that I haven't even been told our orders yet, I want you to believe me.
  • Phase
    Yes. Sergeant.
  • Slick Inatra
    I'd also like you to bathe sometime this tenday.
  • Phase
    Yes, sergeant.
  • Phase
    The locals going to kick us out, sergeant?
  • Slick Inatra
    Just you, Phase. You rob the place of its glamour.
  • Phase
    No loss. Last time I was here they had dice, blood-bouts, the works. Now it's just a lot of sulking pickpockets.
  • Slick Inatra
    Those sulks are paying us, Phase. So chin up, make your coin, and you can lose it somewhere else. Aye?

Notes

  • Slick Inatra acts as the leader of the group of Zhentarim in the Guildhall, until Roah or Boss Friol arrives.
    • She appears to be the one giving orders to the rest of the Zhentarim, and Phase refers to her as a Sergeant.
    • It is not clear if Slick Inatra was aware of the Zhents' true purpose at the Guildhall before the takeover, as she mentions to Phase she has yet to receive any further orders, yet at the same time Carlorina the Wolf and Gravedigger Karcen are seemingly meant to be on alert for an unexplained signal.
  • Slick Inatra uses the same (otherwise) unique hair as Minthara.
